title: PocHIS PCR Protocol
author: Jordan Sims
materials: Gently vortex all PCR reagents. Spin down in mini spinner, if necessary

Add PCR reagents to a 5mL microcentrifuge tube in the following volumes to prepare master mix: 2050µL Taq PCR Master Mix (1025µL x 2) 1722µL molecular grade water (861µL x 2) 82µL 0.1% BSA 82µL 10µM PocHIS forward primer 82µL 10µM PocHIS reverse primer
Plug in and power on thermal cyclers
Open the miniPCR software. Click the “Devices” tab, highlight the desired thermal cycler, and click “Connect” to connect to the thermal cycler

steps.title: Thaw Samples and Reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw the required samples and PCR reagents on the bench.

substeps.instruction: Remove one aliquot each of Taq PCR Master Mix, molecular grade water, 0.1% BSA, 10µM PocHIS forward primer, and 10µM PocHIS reverse primer from the freezer.

steps.title: Prepare Reagent Cooling
steps.instruction: Maintain reagent temperature using an insulated aluminum tube rack.

substeps.instruction: Remove an insulated aluminum tube rack from the freezer.
Place PCR reagents into the rack once they are fully thawed.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Strip Tubes
steps.instruction: Set up and label the reaction vessels.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 10 sets of PCR strip tubes.
Label strips with unique ID and mark the first and last tubes.

steps.title: Prepare Master Mix
steps.instruction: Homogenize and distribute the master mix.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 49µL master mix into all strip tubes.

steps.title: Add DNA Templates
steps.instruction: Add DNA or water to the reaction tubes carefully to avoid bubbles.

substeps.instruction: Add 1µL extracted DNA to each PCR strip tube, or 1µL molecular grade water to negative controls.
Pipette onto the side of the strip tube to avoid introducing a bubble.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Load Tubes
steps.instruction: Ensure all liquid is at the bottom and load into the thermal cycler.

substeps.instruction: Spin the strip tubes down in a mini spinner.
Place strip tubes into miniPCR thermal cyclers.
Record in the lab notebook which strips go into which thermal cycler.

steps.title: Run PCR Protocol
steps.instruction: Initiate the PocHIS PCR program on the thermal cycler.

substeps.instruction: Click the 'Library' tab, highlight the PocHIS protocol, and select 'Run'.
Choose the appropriate thermal cycler and select 'Upload'.
Verify that the PCR protocol has started running.
Confirm the protocol parameters: 94ºC for 60s; 40 cycles of (94ºC for 30s, 53ºC for 30s, and 72ºC for 60s); and a final extension of 72ºC for 300s.

steps.title: Process Remaining Reactions
steps.instruction: Repeat the loading and running process for the remaining samples.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the loading and running steps four more times to start the remaining PCR reactions.

steps.title: Store Amplicons
steps.instruction: Store the resulting PCR amplicons in the fridge.
